slides.title: What does the Alamein Declaration mean for Ethiopia?
Four leaders meet in Egypt
slides.body: The leaders of Egypt, Eritrea and Somalia, and Sudan's army chief, issued a joint declaration in New Alamein on Oct 4, Al Jazeera reported.

slides.title: Red Sea and the Nile
slides.body: It says the Red Sea should be controlled by coastal states. Egypt and Sudan warned against “unilateral measures” that harm downstream states, a reference to the GERD dispute.

slides.title: Accusations and denials
slides.body: Ethiopia accuses Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan of backing the armed alliance fighting the government. All three deny it.

slides.title: An opening for talks
slides.body: Somalia's president said Mogadishu does not object to Ethiopia getting commercial access through Somali ports, if agreed with Somalia.

slides.title: Sea access and the Nile: settle them through dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
